sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Ritesh
 Mr. Lalit 
 Yadav, Adv
 Nagri.

Coram:
 Justice Prathiba M. Singh
 Justice Dharmesh Sharma
 Order

1.  This hearing has been done through hybrid mode. CRL.M.A.3529/2025 (for early hearing)
2.
This is an application seeking early hearing filed on behalf of the Appellant, who is the mother of the deceased.
The matter is in the Regular Board.
The accused has been acquitted in this matter under Sections 498A, 304B, 34 IPC vide judgment dated 28th July, 2025 in Session Case bearing no.15/10, passed by Addl. Session Judge, Karkardooma Court.

Considering the nature of the matter,
early hearing is allowed.
The application is disposed of.
3. In the meantime, notice be given to other Respondents to be served through the concerned SHO.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 15/02/2025 at 00:34:02 4.
List before the Joint Registrar on 27th February, 2025 to ensure service of other Respondents.

5. List this matter for final hearing before the Court on 28th April, 2025.
PRATHIBA M. SINGH, J.
